source.author: lucan
source.text: Ut tempora tandem Furtivae placuere fugae: ne litora clamor Nauticus exagitet, neu buccina dividat horas, Neu tuba praemonitos perducat ad aequora nautas, Praecepit sociis.
source.text_original: Ut tempora tandem / Furtivae placuere fugae: ne litora clamor / Nauticus exagitet, neu buccina dividat horas, / Neu tuba praemonitos perducat ad aequora nautas, / Praecepit sociis.
source.text_english: When the time for the secret flight at last proved favorable, he ordered his companions that no sailor’s shout should rouse the shores, nor should the bugle divide the hours, nor the trumpet bring the warned sailors down to the sea.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: non clamor anhelis nauticus aut blandus testudine defuit Orpheus.
reuse.text_original: non clamor anhelis / nauticus aut blandus testudine defuit Orpheus.
reuse.text_english: there was no sailor’s shout to the breathless, nor did Orpheus, with his lyre, fail to soothe them.
